senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to stand forth, project (cmp. בָּלַט),] to escape.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 41:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLI</cite> <he>ביום רעה אֲמַלֶּטְךָ</he> on the day of evil I shall save thee.
<cite ref="Taanit 23a:13">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>מִילַּטְתּוֹ בתפלתךָ</he> thou hast saved it (the generation) through thy prayer.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 777:1">Yalk. Ps. 777</cite> <he>מיכל מְמַלֶּטֶת וכ׳</he> Michael helped David to escape from within and Jonathan from without; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be saved, to escape. Esth. R. introd. נח ראש לנִמְלָטִים Noah is the first of those saved (mentioned in the Bible).
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:15:8">Koh. R. to IX, 15</cite> <he>כל השומע ליצר טוב נ׳</he> whosoever listens to the suggestions of his good inclination will be saved; a. e.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 854:3">Yalk. Deut. 854</cite> <he>ואתם מִתְמַלְּטִים וכ׳</he> and you will be saved from the judgment of &c.
